source.title: Complement inhibitors and B cell-modifying agents for IgA nephropathy—a Kidney Disease: Improving Global Outcomes (KDIGO) commentary

figures.title: Therapeutic targets and positioning of treatments in IgAN

tables.title: Phase 3 proteinuria and eGFR data for available and emerging IgAN therapeutics as of April 15, 2026

coverage_decisions: The full six-page commentary was inspected, including Figure 1, Table 1, disclosure, disclaimer, and bibliography.
Reported trial results were treated as secondary reports from the commentary.
The explicit no-recommendation boundary was preserved.
The bibliography was extracted separately and not atomized.
source_limitations: No head-to-head comparative trials support ranking the therapies in Table 1.
eGFR outcomes were pending for atrasentan, sibeprenlimab, and atacicept in the source.
Combination-therapy data and long-term safety data for several new mechanisms remain limited.
